title: Scrum Half Quick Service Wide (Chas McIvor)
style: country swing bluegrass banjo brass bongo fast beat 134bpm comedy dad voice spoken interjections southern drawl mandolin harmonica
lyrics:
[Intro - Chas spoken]
I say son, the scrum half is the link
Quick service wide to the fly half, dont blink
Fast hands win games, son, fast hands

[Verse 1]
Arrive at the ruck before the ball is won
Feet planted, knees bent, ready to run
Grab the ball with both hands at the back
Spring up and pass in one fluid track

[Pre-Chorus]
No step before the pass, son, fire it away
The defence sets quick, dont delay
Accuracy and speed, two hands every time
Fly half waiting, hit them on a dime

[Chorus]
Scrum half quick service wide, son
Link the forwards to the backs, the work begun
Two hands on the ball, no step, no delay
Fire it flat, fire it fast, every play

[Verse 2]
Box kick when the line is set, kick deep
Spiral high and hang, the chase is the keep
Snipe the blind side when the gap appears
The nine is the conductor, the eyes and the ears

[Bridge - Chas spoken]
I say boy, the scrum half talks all day
Calling the calls, organising the play
Never silent, always communicating
The nine is the brain, the team coordinating

[Chorus]
Scrum half quick service wide, son
Link the forwards to the backs, the work begun
Two hands on the ball, no step, no delay
Fire it flat, fire it fast, every play

[Outro]
Quick hands, no step
Fire it wide, never inept
Link the forwards and the backs
Thats my boy, fill the cracks
